tagline.en: Alibaba's ali-vilab image-to-video model — MIT-licensed, animates a still image into a short clip.
tagline.zh: 阿里 ali-vilab 的图生视频模型——MIT 许可,可将静态图片生成为短视频片段。

en: I2VGen-XL is an open image-to-video model from Alibaba's ali-vilab group, released under the MIT license. Its main job is to take a still image and animate it into a short video, and it also supports text-to-video generation.

The model is a cascaded, diffusion-based video generator: it conditions on your input image (and optional text) to produce motion that stays faithful to the source frame. In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared pipeline — supply an image, and it generates the corresponding clip.
zh: I2VGen-XL 是阿里 ali-vilab 团队开源的图生视频模型,采用 MIT 许可。它的主要用途是把一张静态图片动画化为短视频,同时也支持文生视频。
该模型是基于扩散的级联式视频生成器:它以输入图片(以及可选文本)为条件,生成忠实于原始画面的运动。在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过统一 pipeline 运行它——提供一张图片,它便生成对应的片段。

whenToUse.en: A good choice when you have a still image you want to bring to life, and want an openly-licensed (MIT) image-to-video model to prototype with.
whenToUse.zh: 当你有一张想让它动起来的静态图片,并希望用一个开放许可(MIT)的图生视频模型做原型时,这是不错的选择。

notFor.en: Checkpoints and assets are downloaded separately and reported as missing at runtime if absent, so make sure they are staged before you generate.
notFor.zh: Checkpoint 与相关资源需单独下载,若缺失会在运行时报出,请在生成前先准备好。

en: Image-to-video: animate a still image into motion
zh: MIT 许可,权重开放可用
图生视频:让静态图片动起来
